ex.en: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
ex.zh: 貨船提早了四個小時抵達。

ex.en: The ship was carrying a cargo of rice.
ex.zh: 那艘船載著一船稻米。

carrier.zh: 運輸業者、航空公司；（電信）業者

ex.en: The airline is the country's largest carrier.
ex.zh: 這家航空公司是該國最大的航空業者。

ex.en: Which mobile carrier do you use?
ex.zh: 你用哪一家電信業者？

ex.en: Has the letter carrier been by yet?
ex.zh: 郵差來過了嗎？

ex.en: Mosquitoes are carriers of disease.
ex.zh: 蚊子會傳播疾病。

ex.en: This factory's productive capacity is 250 cars a week.
ex.zh: 這家工廠每週的產能是 250 輛車。

ex.en: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
ex.zh: 這個房間可以容納 200 個座位。

ex.en: The bus was filled to capacity.
ex.zh: 這輛公車客滿了。

ex.en: Man has a great capacity to adapt to environmental changes.
ex.zh: 人類適應環境變化的能力很強。

ex.en: The cells have the capacity to convert food into energy.
ex.zh: 細胞具有將食物轉化為能量的能力。

ex.en: She attended the meeting in her capacity as manager.
ex.zh: 她以經理的身分出席會議。

ex.en: He worked for us in an advisory capacity.
ex.zh: 他以顧問的身分替我們工作。

ex.en: The scale needs calibration every six months.
ex.zh: 這台秤每六個月需要校準一次。

ex.en: Incorrect calibration can lead to bad data.
ex.zh: 校準不正確會導致資料錯誤。

ex.en: Who is doing the catering for the wedding?
ex.zh: 婚禮的外燴是誰負責的？

ex.en: She runs a small catering business.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小型外燴公司。

ex.en: We started a campaign against smoking.
ex.zh: 我們發起了一項反菸運動。

ex.en: The new ad campaign was very successful.
ex.zh: 新的廣告宣傳活動非常成功。

ex.en: Lobbyists for the bill funneled bribes into a campaign fund.
ex.zh: 支持這項法案的說客把賄款轉入競選基金。

ex.en: She spent millions on her election campaign.
ex.zh: 她在競選活動上花了數百萬。

ex.en: A local restaurant catered the wedding.
ex.zh: 一家本地餐廳承辦了婚宴。

ex.en: We cater for parties of up to 200 people.
ex.zh: 我們承辦最多兩百人的宴會。

ex.en: This is a store that caters specially to students.
ex.zh: 這是一家專門為學生服務的商店。

ex.en: The hotel caters to business travelers.
ex.zh: 這家飯店主要服務商務旅客。

ex.en: She has a lot of carry-on luggage.
ex.zh: 她有很多隨身行李。

ex.en: Liquids in your carry-on bag must be under 100 milliliters.
ex.zh: 隨身行李中的液體每瓶不得超過 100 毫升。

ex.en: You can bring one carry-on and one personal item.
ex.zh: 你可以帶一件隨身行李和一件個人物品。

ex.en: Please put your carry-on in the overhead bin.
ex.zh: 請把隨身行李放進上方的置物櫃。

ex.en: We must cancel our trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 我們必須取消我們去日本的旅行。

ex.en: Tom's flight was delayed and then cancelled.
ex.zh: 湯姆的航班延誤了，然後被取消了。

ex.en: Jack decided to cancel the reservations.
ex.zh: 傑克決定取消預訂。

ex.en: My plan is visiting old castles in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我的計劃是參觀蘇格蘭的古堡。

ex.en: The site of the castle is now a park.
ex.zh: 城堡的舊址現在變成了公園。

ex.en: In the background of the picture is a castle.
ex.zh: 圖片的背景是一座城堡。

ex.en: Please send me your latest product catalog.
ex.zh: 請寄給我你們最新的產品型錄。

ex.en: You can find the price in the catalog.
ex.zh: 價格可以在型錄上查到。

ex.en: We were just talking about you when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候，我們正好在聊你。

ex.en: I'll give you a call when I get home.
ex.zh: 我到家後給你打電話。

ex.en: This weekend we can make telephone calls for free.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們可以免費打電話。

ex.en: I missed three calls during the meeting.
ex.zh: 我開會時漏接了三通電話。

ex.en: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
ex.zh: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就氣得不得了。

ex.en: President Lincoln was what we call a self-made man.
ex.zh: 林肯總統就是我們所說的白手起家的人。

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: They called off the meeting at the last minute.
ex.zh: 他們在最後一刻取消了會議。

ex.en: I will call back a bit later.
ex.zh: 我晚一點再回電。

ex.en: Can you ask her to call me back?
ex.zh: 可以請她回電給我嗎？

ex.en: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
ex.zh: 他是那個職位最有希望的候選人。

ex.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
ex.zh: 這個職位最理想的應徵者要有四年工作經驗。

ex.en: He is one of the candidates running for mayor.
ex.zh: 他是市長的候選人之一。

ex.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
ex.zh: 說也奇怪，沒有人投票給那位候選人。

ex.en: She wants to go to Beijing to further her career.
ex.zh: 她想去北京發展她的事業。

ex.en: He always kept an open mind about his future career.
ex.zh: 他對未來的職涯一直抱持開放的態度。

ex.en: His political career is done for.
ex.zh: 他的政治生涯完蛋了。
